placements.why: Establishes an organizational strata category for operational reliability and disaster recovery verification based on Quinton's mandate and readiness principle.
placements.title: Verification of recovery systems through regular operational practice
placements.frame: How does the organization validate that operational resilience procedures actually work before incidents occur?

placements.title: A rollback capability exists only if routinely rehearsed
placements.frame: How do we distinguish genuine recovery capability from theoretical procedures?
placements.why: Captures the core directional principle that unrehearsed operational rollback procedures do not constitute actual capabilities and must be verified through regular drills.
